name: 11710 · Bellmore, NY
findings: ZIP 11710 (Bellmore) has 89 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11710 (Bellmore) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 11710 (Bellmore) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.text: 10 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
